name: Black
note: Bambu K from 8-colour LUT: single K layer under 1-3 whites implies o_K 0.96-1.0 (TD <= 0.17); all-stack scalar fit o=0.997-1.0.

name: White
note: W^m X^(5-m) veils: 4-colour session o_W=0.057-0.060 (TD 9.1-9.6); 8-colour session o_W=0.08-0.15 (TD 3.5-6.7). 5.0 is the compromise; measured band 3.5-9.5. Per-channel: white is slightly bluish-transparent (R more transparent).

name: Coffee Brown
note: Dark pigment between K (0.15) and Red (0.50); like Red it should transmit its own (red) channel more.

name: Klein Blue
note: Proxy = Bambu Deep Blue #0A2989 (all-stack scalar o 0.80-0.90 in the two sessions). Klein Blue is lighter/more chromatic, so it is probably somewhat MORE translucent (TD 0.3-0.5). Blue channel transmits strongly (TD_B 2.1).

name: Red
note: Identical Bambu SKU. All-stack scalar fit o=0.644 (4-colour) / 0.702 (8-colour). One red layer over white already looks fully red (convergence TD 0.21-0.30), but red light passes through (TD_R 3.3): red over black is a dark maroon.

name: Green
note: Identical Bambu SKU (8-colour session only). Scalar o=0.554; green channel transmits (TD_G 1.76).

name: Sunny Orange
note: Geometric mean of Red (0.50) and Yellow (1.8). Per-channel: R transparent like Red/Yellow, G between Red-G 0.29 and Yellow-G 1.9, B absorbed.

name: Oak
note: Mid-tone tan (L*~60): white base + brown pigment. More opaque than the pastels, less than Yellow's absorbed channel.

name: Lavender Purple
note: Pastel (L*~62): white base + violet (M+C-like) pigment. Derived from M (scalar TD 1.9) / C (0.89) diluted towards white (5.0).

name: Pink
note: Very pale pastel (L*~76): essentially white (5.0) with a little magenta pigment -> slightly more opaque than white; green channel absorbed most.

name: Beige
note: Near-white (L*~88): white + a little yellow/brown pigment; pigment adds absorption so slightly more opaque than white.

name: Vivid Yellow
note: Bambu Yellow #F4EE2A ~ user's #F4E62A. All-stack scalar fit o=0.214 (4-colour) / 0.326 (8-colour) -> 0.27; over white one layer already looks fully yellow (convergence TD 0.19-0.24) because only the blue channel is absorbed (TD_B 0.30) while R/G pass (3.1/1.9).
